nieuw.titel: Advance before wheeling to reach an obstructed charge target
nieuw.tekst: Consider advancing straight before wheeling during a charge when wheeling immediately would leave the route blocked by a model or terrain.
nieuw.voorbeeld: In his game against Wood Elves, the Wild Riders advanced about five inches before wheeling to reach his Shaman beside a tower. He had thought an immediate wheel would leave their charge blocked, but this approach forced him to flee.

bronnen.citaat: So remember that you can wheel at any time during the charge

overgeslagen: Skipped the introduction, spell and rally outcomes, and rules commentary except where needed to explain the delayed-wheel example.
